label: p2 stage B, restarted onto the shared close-out (eight arms, 255-271M transitions)
notes:
The same pass as `p2-stageb`, restarted on 2026-08-30 08:20 so that it runs `tools/closeout.py` -- the close-out both boxes now share -- instead of the `sh -c` chain of one `evaluate.py` per arm that `desktop/runner/launch.py` used to build. **Nothing is lost by the restart:** every shard resumes from its own rows on disk, so this picks up where `p2-stageb` stopped, minus at most one in-flight row per shard.

What it buys, beyond the two boxes running the same file: a stage-B window on the box's monitor, one panel per arm, redrawn off the shard files while the pass runs -- and the same behaviour on a failing arm as the laptop, which is that the arms behind it still run.

No selector, deliberately: the protocol's default decides, and that is `screen:97`. The reward env is carried so stage B's `avg_reward` column is on the objective the arms trained on.
